policy: Rules may group sources and describe optional retrieval/conversion for retained local artifacts. A human-reviewed official reference may be used within the publisher, identity, language, version, passage, and caveats actually checked without capture, conversion, hashes, replay, or reproduction permission. reference_use_policy: For every source type, prefer the responsible official publisher. Prefer a usable government-published consolidation for national legislation and the responsible EU publisher consolidation for EU legislation; if none is usable, use the closest government-published or official-service version and record its language, displayed date/cutoff, scope, and limits. A human-reviewed official link is enough for ordinary research; a custom capture/conversion rule, local copy, API, replay check, or updater is optional. Use Gazette fragments only to resolve a material question; do not reconstruct a full chain by default. Keep reference use, local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, and country completion separate.
